command: import fs from "node:fs"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; const rows=[]; for(const [id,url]of [["rule-20261106","https://dm.takaratomy.co.jp/img/dm_rule_20261106.pdf"],["qa-31707","https://dm.takaratomy.co.jp/rule/qa/31707/"]]){const r=await fetch(url,{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(30000)});if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.status);const b=Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()),file="tmp/duema-target-10000/research/"+id+(id.startsWith("rule")?".pdf":".html");fs.writeFileSync(file,b);rows.push({source:url,sha256:createHash("sha256").update(b).digest("hex"),file,checkedAt:new Date().toISOString()});}fs.writeFileSync("tmp/duema-target-10000/rule-evidence-1838.json",JSON.stringify(rows,null,2)+"\n"); console.log(rows.map(x=>({source:x.source,sha256:x.sha256})));
